meta.title: Tech+RFQ project (RFQ stage): counter offer rejected

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ event on the RFQ Responses tab with Vendor A's bid.
Send the buyer's counter offer of 90 against the vendor's own bid.
Verify the counter offer is marked as initiated for the vendor.
Move to the separate vendor portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event overview where the pending counter offer and vendor response controls are shown.

args.goal: in the vendor portal, reject the pending counter offer of 90 and stop when the rejection is confirmed and the original bid is shown

steps.note: Reject is not represented by a dedicated catalog step, so perform and verify the vendor-side rejection on the open portal screen.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Open the buyer's Master QCS to verify the RFQ bid after rejection.
Assert that the vendor's original RFQ price remains 100 rather than the rejected counter offer of 90.
